advisories.whyNotBlocking: The prompt states that append-only COORD after this remeasurement, with those files unmoved, is PASS-NO-SCOPE-EFFECT and is not a MUST-FIX, and lists charging it as one among the traps to avoid. Escalating the identical fact to SHOULD-FIX would block CONSENT and defeat that rule by relabeling, so it is not charged at either level. There is no scope effect on the merits: D-121 targets DR-110, this draft targets DR-104, the two do not interact, and the draft's substantive non-retargeting claim that 'This cycle does not retarget any D-110 through D-122 draft' remains true. The draft also anticipates exactly this, instructing that 'The apply writer re-measures COORD at adoption.'
